run_getCameraImageTest: run the pybullet script to capture RGB, depth, and segmentation images from a camera view
build_getCameraImage: build a pybullet module that uses getCameraImage to capture RGB and depth images with OpenGL or Tiny renderer
create_computeViewMatrix: create a function that computes a view matrix using computeViewMatrix with camera eye, target, and up vectors
create_computeProjectionMatrixFOV: create a function that computes a projection matrix using computeProjectionMatrixFOV with fov, aspect ratio, near and far planes
refactor_changeVisualShape: refactor the pybullet scene to use changeVisualShape for setting rgbaColor or textureUniqueId on loaded URDF bodies
